text:
maya: Heads up — nightly CI showed a perf dip on the replay harness for kernel selection path. seeing ~9% p95 throughput regression vs baseline.
ci-bot: nightly-bench: run 2026-03-17T03:12Z finished. alert: throughput_regression >= 5% on model redwood-7B-q4. details: https://ci.internal/bench/1772501234 
sam: quick question — is this from synthetic traffic or replay?
maya: replay harness (replay_id=r-20260317-044) against a dedicated pool. config used: batch_size=8, max_seq=1024, kernel_policy=auto, kv_cache=enabled.
liam: digging into profiler: I see a kernel fallback around step ~1200 to generic_gemm for matmul_512. kv cache stats low hits during that phase. Link to flame: https://perf.internal/flame/1772501234 
maya: paste of profiler snippet: 
```
[perf] step=1204 kernel_selected=generic_gemm matmul=512x512 time=1.9ms
[cache] kv_hits=0.12 kv_evictions=23 kv_items=420
[latency] p95=182ms baseline_p95=168ms
```

nora: CI auto-alert created INC-1772502 and notified eng-sre. threshold was 5% so it fired.
sam: this smells like the kernel selector rule reordering we changed last sprint (sam/opt-kernel-rules). can someone bisect which commit flipped the priority?
maya: I did a local compare: master@1769450000 -> HEAD shows ordering change for matmul size bracket 256-768 (prefer_fused moved after generic fallback).
liam: quick mitigation: pin kernel_policy=prefer_fused for redwood-7B-q4 in nightly job and re-run the replay. @ci-bot can you please trigger a rerun with that override?
ci-bot: triggered rerun: nightly-bench/1772503000 params={"kernel_policy":"prefer_fused","batch_size":"8","replay_id":"r-20260317-044"}. started.
ci-bot: rerun finished 2026-03-17T04:20Z. result summary: p95=169ms, throughput delta ~+1% vs baseline. regression resolved. report: https://ci.internal/bench/1772503000/report
sam: ok good. Action items: 1) add unit coverage for kernel selector on matmul 256-768, 2) make replay harness run an optional KV warmup (current synthetic traffic doesn't exercise warm cache enough), 3) add a CI guard that fails if kernel selector flips ordering without a perf signoff.
nora: I'm adding this to flaky-test triage list since the current nightly was flaky because of selector nondeterminism. opening PERF-1137 to track follow-ups.
maya: also want to publish a small dashboard diff to Grafana under nightly/replay/kernel-selection so product and infra can see trendlines.
liam: PR up: sam/patch/kernel-selector-guard — includes the test + docs + a change to the selector to prefer fused for 256-768 unless explicitly disabled. will monitor next night.
maya: thanks, team. small postmortem note: need to expand our apples-to-apples comparison template in CI so kernel_policy and kv_warmup are identical between baseline and candidate runs.
sam: agreed — I'll update the CI job template and add a flag --kv-warmup to the replay harness.
maya: :thumbsup: keep updates in this thread and paste the next nightly results here.
